//: Compiles the HAND-WRITTEN TypeScript sources (auth/, examples/) plus their specs into .test-build/ for `npm test`. The directory globs are deliberate: a NEW hand-written .ts file is compiled -- and therefore coverage-gated by .c8rc.json -- without editing any config. `rootDir: "."` keeps the emitted layout mirroring the repo so the generated api/ stubs stay reachable at .test-build/api (copied there by the pretest script) and so c8 can map coverage back onto the original .ts sources.
